per_user_speed_is_not_capacity.boundary: This is revenue-hurdle arithmetic, not a capacity estimate. Per-user streaming speed cannot be multiplied by users without the undisclosed concurrency-throughput curve, batching behavior, input work, cache hits, failures, and SLO tails.

business_implications.easy_thesis: a provider can win merely by replacing a generic serving abstraction with per-model kernels, scheduling, and automatic deployment tuning
business_implications.reason: Baseten publicly reports the same model, quantization, runtime, cache-routing, disaggregation, and speculation layers already combined in production; Fireworks publicly reports the same model-specific stack plus automatic hardware-model-software workload adaptation
business_implications.surviving_wedge: an automated co-design system that reaches quality-controlled model-architecture or hardware changes incumbents do not already deploy, or validates useful changes materially faster across models
business_implications.comparison_policy: No provider-advantage result may compare a candidate against BF16, a single generic parallelism map, an aggregated-only serving path, cache-unaware routing, or MTP-disabled execution when the incumbent exposes the stronger path.
business_implications.open_falsification_test: Show a quality- and SLO-controlled cost reduction beyond this incumbent stack on the same agent trace, including aggregate capacity, utilization, failures, and fully loaded cost.
